vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: workflow-builder-lite
Version: 1.7.0

The workflow-builder-lite skill is a logic-based tool designed to help the agent plan and simulate multi-step workflows. The instructions in SKILL.md explicitly prohibit shell execution, file persistence, and unauthorized data access, limiting the agent to built-in tools like web_fetch and browser for simulation purposes only. No indicators of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt-injection attacks were found.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose: it plans and simulates short, session-only workflows using built-in agent tools and requests no extra credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (build & simulate multi-step workflows) align with the SKILL.md. The skill requests no binaries, env vars, or installs, which is proportional for a planner/simulator that uses only the agent's built-in tools.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within the stated scope: build/dry-run/execute workflows using built-in message/browser/web_fetch tools, no shell exec, no implicit file I/O, and workflows are session-only. The doc explicitly forbids file writes and shell exec unless the user explicitly asks to perform those actions separately.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk installation surface. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested. The SKILL.md does reference suggesting another skill (smart-api-connector) for complex REST calls; that other skill may require credentials, so users should evaluate it separately when prompted.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is not requesting persistent or system-level privileges. It performs actions only via the agent's built-in tools and keeps workflows in-session per the documentation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and does not request credentials or install code. Before installing, be aware that: 1) it will make outbound HTTP/browser requests and can send messages via the agent's tools — so only provide API endpoints or targets you trust; 2) the skill may recommend using other skills (e.g., smart-api-connector) which could require credentials — review those separately before granting access; 3) workflows are session-only (not persisted), so save anything important yourself if needed. No code files were present for static scanning, so the runtime behavior depends entirely on the agent's built-in tools as described.
